# Run, Goblins!

> Run, Goblins! is a free 3D asymmetric hide-and-seek browser game (1 elf vs 8 goblins). Play as the elf and capture every goblin within 10 minutes, or as a goblin and survive with your crew. Solo vs AI or online multiplayer for up to 9 players with a 6-digit room code. No download or sign-up; works on desktop and mobile browsers with WebGL 2.

- Play: {{SITE_URL}}
- Sides: Harp Elf (Gaze, Harp, Stun, Capture), Amethyst Violinist elf (Invisibility, Assassin's Eye, Charge, Capture), Cave Goblin (Dash, Interfere, Break Free, Goblin Radar)
- Terrains: Verdant Meadow (a grassland with five goblin caves, two entrances each) or Mushroom Hollow (a night mushroom forest with two caves and three raised ledges reached by portals, plus bounce mushrooms and sight-blocking spore vents); a cage at the center. Online rooms vote for the terrain (elf 1.5 votes, goblins 1 each, 20-second countdown)
- Match length: up to 10 minutes
- Languages: English, Traditional Chinese
- Price: free
